name: Form: Publish

description.en: Publish a public form in the Form store so other teams can discover and install it. The original form remains owned by the current team.
description.de: Veröffentliche ein öffentliches Formular im Formular-Store, damit andere Teams es finden und installieren können. Das Original bleibt im Besitz des aktuellen Teams.

bot: Use this when the user wants to make an existing form installable from the Form store.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug that owns this form. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug, dem dieses Formular gehört. Standardmäßig wird das aktuelle Team verwendet.

inputs.bot: Pass the business team slug that owns the form (e.g. lernstudio-satzinger). Omit to use the current team. Required when the form belongs to a different team than the agent home team.

success.en: Form published in the Form store.
